name: Besqab AB (publ)
summary: Besqab AB (publ) develops residential housing properties in Sweden. It operates through two segments: Project Development and Investment Properties. The Project Development segment offers housing, rental apartments and ownership rights, development of nursing homes, rental properties, and other community services. The Investment Properties segment consists of completed rental apartments, nursing homes, and other community service properties. It executes projects through general contracting and shared contracting models with site management.
